abathur.name: Symbiote
abathur.desc: Spawn and attach a Symbiote to a target ally or Structure. While active, Abathur controls the Symbiote, gaining access to new Abilities. The Symbiote is able to gain XP from nearby enemy deaths.

abathur.name: Toxic Nest
abathur.desc: Spawn a mine that becomes active after a short time. Deals 153 (+4% per level) damage and reveals the enemy for 4 seconds. Lasts 90 seconds.  Stores up to 3 charges.

abathur.name: Evolve Monstrosity
abathur.desc: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times.  The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.  Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits.  This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

abathur.name: Ultimate Evolution
abathur.desc: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

abathur.name: Locust Strain
abathur.desc: Spawns a Locust to attack down the nearest lane every 15 seconds. Locusts last for 16 seconds, have 350 (+4% per level) health and deal 46 (+4% per level) damage with each Basic Attack, dealing 25% bonus damage to enemy Structures.

abathur.name: Carapace
abathur.desc: Shields the assisted ally for 150 (+4% per level). Allied Heroes are healed for 22 (+4% per level) Health per second while the Shield is active. Lasts for 6 seconds.

abathur.name: Stab
abathur.desc: Shoots a spike towards target area that deals 119 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy it contacts.

abathur.name: Spike Burst
abathur.desc: Deals 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

alarak.name: Discord Strike
alarak.desc: After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165 (+4% per level) damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.

alarak.name: Telekinesis
alarak.desc: Vector Targeting Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

alarak.name: Lightning Surge
alarak.desc: Deal 62 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 70 (+4% per level) health for each Hero hit.

alarak.name: Deadly Charge
alarak.desc: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.  Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

alarak.name: Counter-Strike
alarak.desc: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

alarak.name: Sadism
alarak.desc: Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes.  Repeatable Quest: Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.

alexstrasza.name: Gift of Life
alexstrasza.desc: Sacrifice 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an allied Hero for 150% of that amount.  Passive: Increase Alexstrasza's Health regeneration by 150%.  Dragonqueen: Breath of Life Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.

alexstrasza.name: Abundance
alexstrasza.desc: Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 20% of their maximum Health.  Dragonqueen: Preservation Heal area and amount greatly increased.

alexstrasza.name: Flame Buffet
alexstrasza.desc: Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for 75 (+4% per level) damage over 5.5 seconds.  Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by 40% decaying over 2 seconds, and refunds the Mana cost.  Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.

alexstrasza.name: Life-Binder
alexstrasza.desc: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.

alexstrasza.name: Cleansing Flame
alexstrasza.desc: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.  2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

alexstrasza.name: Dragonqueen
alexstrasza.desc: After 1.25 seconds, transform into a dragon and gain 500 (+4% per level) Health.  While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Abilities are empowered, and her Basic Attacks deal 143 (+4% per level) damage and heal allied Heroes for 43 (+4% per level) in an arc in front of her. Additionally, the duration of incoming Stuns, Roots, and Slows, is reduced by 50%.  Lasts 15 seconds.

alexstrasza.name: Breath of Life
alexstrasza.desc: Heal an allied Hero for 20% of Alexstrasza's current Health.

alexstrasza.name: Preservation
alexstrasza.desc: Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 30% of their maximum Health.

alexstrasza.name: Wing Buffet
alexstrasza.desc: Deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area, knocking them back and Slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds.

alexstrasza.name: Dragonqueen
alexstrasza.desc: Alexstrasza has transformed into a powerful dragon aspect, gaining 500 (+4% per level) Health, resistance to disabling effects, and empowered Basic Attacks and Abilities.

alexstrasza.name: Cleansing Flame
alexstrasza.desc: Take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.  2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

ana.name: Healing Dart
ana.desc: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195 (+4% per level) Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

ana.name: Biotic Grenade
ana.desc: Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152 (+4% per level) Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60 (+4% per level) damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds.

ana.name: Sleep Dart
ana.desc: Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds.  Cannot be used on Vehicles.

ana.name: Nano Boost
ana.desc: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.  Cannot be used on Ana.

ana.name: Eye of Horus
ana.desc: Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.  Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

ana.name: Shrike
ana.desc: Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds, plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike.  Aim Down Sights  Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.

anduin.name: Flash Heal
anduin.desc: Cast for 0.75 seconds to heal an allied Hero for 280 (+4% per level).

anduin.name: Divine Star
anduin.desc: Send light that deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and then returns to Anduin, healing allied Heroes for 130 (+4% per level) in a wider path. Healing increases by 25% per enemy Hero hit.

anduin.name: Chastise
anduin.desc: Shove a swell of light forward, dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Rooting them for 1.25 seconds.

anduin.name: Holy Word: Salvation
anduin.desc: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

anduin.name: Lightbomb
anduin.desc: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

anduin.name: Leap of Faith
anduin.desc: Faith instantly pulls an allied Hero to Anduin's location, granting them Unstoppable while they travel.  Pursued By Grace  Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes heal the lowest Health allied Hero near Anduin for 32 (+4% per level).

anubarak.name: Impale
anubarak.desc: Deals 90 (+4% per level) damage. Stuns for 1 second.

anubarak.name: Harden Carapace
anubarak.desc: Gain a Shield that grants 40 Spell Armor and absorbs 340 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

anubarak.name: Burrow Charge
anubarak.desc: Burrow to the target location, dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage and briefly stunning enemies in a small area upon surfacing, slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds.  Burrow Charge can be reactivated to surface early.

anubarak.name: Locust Swarm
anubarak.desc: Deal 68 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each enemy damaged restores 24 (+4% per level) Health. Lasts 6 seconds.

anubarak.name: Cocoon
anubarak.desc: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

anubarak.name: Scarab Host
anubarak.desc: Using an Ability spawns a Beetle which lasts for 8 seconds, attacking nearby enemies for 20 (+4% per level) damage.

artanis.name: Blade Dash
artanis.desc: Dash forward and deal 63 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, then return and deal 171 (+4% per level) damage. Every enemy hit reduces the cooldown on Shield Overload by 1 second, and Heroes by 2 seconds.

artanis.name: Twin Blades
artanis.desc: Artanis's next Basic Attack immediately causes him to charge a short distance and strike the enemy 2 times.

artanis.name: Phase Prism
artanis.desc: Fire a Phase Prism that deals 66 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit and swaps Artanis's position with theirs. Hitting a Hero also grants Artanis Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Can be used during Blade Dash.

artanis.name: Purifier Beam
artanis.desc: Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move.  Unlimited range.

artanis.name: Suppression Pulse
artanis.desc: Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.

artanis.name: Shield Overload
artanis.desc: After taking damage while below 75% Health, Artanis gains a 365 (+4% per level) Shield for 5 seconds. Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Shield Overload by 4 seconds.

arthas.name: Death Coil
arthas.desc: Deals 164 (+4% per level) damage to target enemy.  Can be self-cast to heal for 262 (+4% per level) Health.

arthas.name: Howling Blast
arthas.desc: Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68 (+4% per level) damage.

arthas.name: Frozen Tempest
arthas.desc: Deal 40 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow their Movement Speed by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.

arthas.name: Army of the Dead
arthas.desc: Summons Ghouls that last 15 seconds and atttack for 20 (+4% per level) damage. Sacrifice Ghouls to heal for 267 (+4% per level) Health.

arthas.name: Summon Sindragosa
arthas.desc: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

arthas.name: Frostmourne Hungers
arthas.desc: Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 99 (+4% per level) increased damage. Dealing damage restores 30 Mana.

auriel.name: Sacred Sweep
auriel.desc: Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and an additional 160 (+4% per level) damage to enemies caught in the center.

auriel.name: Ray of Heaven
auriel.desc: Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.

auriel.name: Detainment Strike
auriel.desc: Deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage.

auriel.name: Resurrect
auriel.desc: Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 5 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.  Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

auriel.name: Crystal Aegis
auriel.desc: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.

auriel.name: Bestow Hope
auriel.desc: Passive: 60% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 20% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy.  Bestow an allied Hero with Hope.  While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time.  Auriel can store up to 475 (+4% per level) energy.

azmodan.name: Globe of Annihilation
azmodan.desc: Shoot a globe of destruction, dealing 176 (+4% per level) damage on impact.  Quest: Hitting a Hero or killing a Minion within 1.5 seconds of being hit by Globe of Annihilation grants 2 Annihilation.  Reward: Each stack of Annihilation increases the damage of Globe of Annihilation by 1, up to 400.

azmodan.name: Summon Demon Warrior
azmodan.desc: Spawn a Demon Warrior that marches forward. Warriors deal 35 (+4% per level) damage per Attack and 18 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every second. Lasts for 10 seconds.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

azmodan.name: All Shall Burn
azmodan.desc: Channel a beam of death on an enemy, dealing 128 (+4% per level) damage per second for 2.5 seconds. If the Channel lasts its full duration, deal an extra 340 (+4% per level) damage to the target.  Azmodan's Movement Speed is reduced by 30% while Channeling.

azmodan.name: Demonic Invasion
azmodan.desc: Rain a small army of Demonic Grunts down on enemies, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage per impact. Grunts deal 39 (+4% per level) damage, have 750 (+4% per level) Health and last up to 10 seconds. When Grunts die they explode, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, doubled against enemy Heroes.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

azmodan.name: Tide of Sin
azmodan.desc: Activate to make the next Globe of Annihilation cost no Mana and deal 50% more damage.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

azmodan.name: Demon Lieutenant
azmodan.desc: Summon a Demon Lieutenant at any allied Mercenary, Minion, or Azmodan Demon. The Lieutenant will cast Demonic Smite every 7 seconds, instantly killing an enemy Minion. Lasts 20 seconds.  Usable while Channeling All Shall Burn.

blaze.name: Flame Stream
blaze.desc: Fire two streams that deal 76 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit by both streams. Flame Stream Ignites Oil Spills it comes in contact with.

blaze.name: Oil Spill
blaze.desc: Vector Targeting Dispense a slick of oil that lasts for 5 seconds and Slows enemies that come in contact with it by 50%.  Oil Spills are Ignited for 2.5 seconds when hit by Flame Stream. Ignited Oil Spills no longer Slow enemies, but instead deal 16 (+4% per level) damage to them every 0.3 seconds. Additionally, Blaze is healed for 49 (+4% per level) Health every 0.3 seconds while standing in Ignited Oil Spills.  Stores up to 2 charges.

blaze.name: Jet Propulsion
blaze.desc: After 0.375 seconds, charge forward. Colliding with an enemy Hero deals 52 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemy Heroes and Stuns them for 1.25 seconds.

blaze.name: Bunker Drop
blaze.desc: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

blaze.name: Combustion
blaze.desc: Channel for up to 2.6 seconds. Upon ending, Slow nearby enemies by 60% and deal 55 (+4% per level) damage to them every 0.5 seconds. Combustion's Slow and damage over time duration is extended the longer Blaze Channels, from 1 second up to 5 seconds.  Blaze's Movement Speed is reduced by 40% while Channeling.

blaze.name: Pyromania
blaze.desc: Gain 40 Armor and deal 40 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds.  Each Hero hit by Flame Stream reduces Pyromania's cooldown by 4 seconds.

brightwing.name: Arcane Flare
brightwing.desc: Shoot a flare dealing 75 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the center. If a Hero is hit by the center, Soothing Mist's passive healing instantly activates.

brightwing.name: Polymorph
brightwing.desc: Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Slowing their Movement Speed by 30% and Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.

brightwing.name: Pixie Dust
brightwing.desc: Increase target Hero's Movement Speed by 20%, and grant them 30 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing Spell damage taken by 30%.

brightwing.name: Blink Heal
brightwing.desc: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

brightwing.name: Emerald Wind
brightwing.desc: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and pushing enemies away.

brightwing.name: Soothing Mist
brightwing.desc: Activate to remove all Stun, Root, Slow, and Silence effects from nearby allied Heroes.  Passive: Brightwing heals nearby allied Heroes for 110 (+4% per level) every 4 seconds

cassia.name: Lightning Fury
cassia.desc: Hurl a lightning javelin that deals 158 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and splits into two lightning bolts that deal 158 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their path.

cassia.name: Blinding Light
cassia.desc: After 0.5 seconds, deal 50 (+4% per level) damage and Blind enemies in the target area for 2 seconds.  Passive: Cassia deals 15% increased damage to Blinded targets.

cassia.name: Fend
cassia.desc: Charge at an enemy, and upon arriving Channel for up to 1.5 seconds, dealing 64 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of Cassia every 0.25 seconds. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes. Avoidance remains charged while Channeling.

cassia.name: Ball Lightning
cassia.desc: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.

cassia.name: Valkyrie
cassia.desc: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

cassia.name: Avoidance
cassia.desc: While moving, Cassia gradually gains up to 30 Armor over 3 seconds. After being stationary for 0.75 seconds, the Armor is rapidly lost over .5 seconds.  Avoidance remains charged while Fending.

chen.name: Flying Kick
chen.desc: Kick through target enemy, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage.

chen.name: Keg Smash
chen.desc: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage and soak enemies in Brew for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 10%. After 1.25 seconds, the Slow is increased to 40%.  After being used, this ability becomes Breath of Fire.  Breath of Fire Deal damage and Ignite Brew-soaked enemies.

chen.name: Stagger
chen.desc: Damage taken over the next 3 seconds is prevented.  Once this effect ends, Chen receives 75% of the damage taken over 5 seconds.  This damage cannot be modified.

chen.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
chen.desc: After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.  Storm can grant the spirits a Shield.  Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies.  Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

chen.name: Wandering Keg
chen.desc: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

chen.name: Fortifying Brew
chen.desc: Chen drinks from his keg, gaining 50 Brew and 180 (+4% per level) temporary Shields per second, up to a maximum of 540 (+4% per level) while drinking. Shields persist for 4 seconds after he stops drinking.

chen.name: Breath of Fire
chen.desc: Breathe a cone of flames, dealing 85 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies that are soaked in Brew are Ignited, dealing 171 (+4% per level) additional damage over 3 seconds and adding 1.5 seconds to the duration of the Slow from Keg Smash.   After being used or after 6 seconds, this ability becomes Keg Smash.  Keg Smash Damage and Slow enemies.

chen.name: Storm
chen.desc: The spirits gain a Shield for 400 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds.  If this is the final Ability cast, the shield amount is increased to 750 (+4% per level) with no limited duration, and the duration of Storm, Earth, Fire is increased by 5 seconds.

chen.name: Earth
chen.desc: Fire and Earth leap to the target location, dealing 32 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies in a large area by 70% for 1.5 seconds.  If this is the final Ability cast, increase the damage dealt by 300% and instead of Slowing, the leap Roots enemy Heroes hit for 1.75 seconds.

chen.name: Fire
chen.desc: Increase the Attack Speed and Basic Attack damage of the spirits by 50% for 5 seconds.  If this is the final Ability cast, the Attack Speed and damage bonus is increased to 75% and the spirits gain 50% Movement Speed for its duration.

chogall.name: Surging Fist
chogall.desc: Activate to begin charging Surging Fist. Activate again to dash forward, knocking aside enemies and dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage. The dash range increases by up to 250%, depending on how long it is charged.

chogall.name: Consuming Blaze
chogall.desc: Ignite nearby enemies, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. Basic Attacking burning enemies re-Ignites them. Cho is healed for 40 (+4% per level) when an enemy is Ignited.

chogall.name: Rune Bomb
chogall.desc: Roll a bomb dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. Gall can use Runic Blast to detonate it to deal 210 (+4% per level) damage in an area.

chogall.name: Upheaval
chogall.desc: After 1 second, pull enemies towards Cho'gall, Slowing them by 25% for 3 seconds and dealing 175 (+4% per level) damage.

chogall.name: Hammer of Twilight
chogall.desc: Activate to swing the Hammer of Twilight, dealing 150 (+4.5% per level) damage, pushing enemies away, and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.  Passive: Cho's Basic Attacks deal 25% increased damage.

chogall.name: Ogre Hide
chogall.desc: Activate to gain 25 Armor, but reduce Gall's damage by 25%.

chromie.name: Sand Blast
chromie.desc: After 0.5 seconds, fire a missile that deals 305 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Deals 50% damage to Structures.  Casting Sand Blast leaves an Echo behind that mimics Chromie's Sand Blast and Basic Attack, dealing 40% damage. Maximum of 1 Echo active at a time.

chromie.name: Dragon's Breath
chromie.desc: Vector Targeting Launch 3 blasts into the air that land every 0.75 seconds towards the targeted direction, dealing 215 (+4% per level) damage each.

chromie.name: Time Trap
chromie.desc: Place a Time Trap that arms and Stealths after 2 seconds. Chromie's Trait can be activated to detonate the trap, placing all nearby allied or enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 2 seconds. Maximum of 1 trap active at a time.

chromie.name: Temporal Loop
chromie.desc: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they are teleported back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.  Basic Abilities recharge 500% faster for 3 seconds after casting Temporal Loop.

chromie.name: Slowing Sands
chromie.desc: Summon a sand vortex that Slows enemies by 10% every 0.25 seconds, up to 70%.

chromie.name: Timewalker
chromie.desc: Chromie has traveled to the future, and as such, will learn her Talents 2 levels earlier than her teammates!  Detonate Time Trap  Detonates active Time Traps.

deathwing.name: Molten Flame
deathwing.desc: After 1.5 seconds, Deathwing breathes a stream of flame, dealing 21 (+4% per level) damage every 0.125 seconds. Drains 30 Energy per second.

deathwing.name: Incinerate
deathwing.desc: After 0.75 seconds, Deathwing flaps his wings, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  World Breaker: Lava Burst Create a lava pool that damages and Slows

deathwing.name: Onslaught
deathwing.desc: After 0.5 seconds, Deathwing lunges in a direction dealing 38 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Deathwing bites enemies at the end of the lunge, dealing an additional 72 (+4% per level) damage.  World Breaker: Earth Shatter Damage and Stun enemies in two lines

deathwing.name: Cataclysm
deathwing.desc: After 2 seconds, Deathwing flies in the targeted direction, dealing 90 (+4% per level) damage on impact and leaving scorched ground that deals 36 (+4% per level) damage a second. Lasts 6 seconds.

deathwing.name: Aspect of Death
deathwing.desc: Deathwing is fitted with 4 Armor Plates which grant 10 Armor each. Every 25% Health lost causes Deathwing to lose a plate. Plates are only restored when Dragonflight is used, based on the amount of Health Deathwing has when landing.  Deathwing is also a mighty Dragon Aspect who is permanently Unstoppable and deals 100% additional Spell Damage to Heroes, but views his allies with contempt and ignores any of their friendly effects.

deathwing.name: Destroyer
deathwing.desc: After 1.75 seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area and landing in Destroyer form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities 3 seconds after landing.

deathwing.name: World Breaker
deathwing.desc: After 1.75 seconds, Deathwing slams down to the ground, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area and landing in World Breaker form. Deathwing can begin to cast Abilities 3 seconds after landing.

deathwing.name: Earth Shatter
deathwing.desc: Create a fissure of earth that deals 90 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Stuns them for 0.75 seconds.  Destroyer: Onslaught Lunge in a direction

deathwing.name: Lava Burst
deathwing.desc: After a 1 second delay, deal 30 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in an area and create a pool of magma that deals 24 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slows enemies by 35%. Lasts 6 seconds.  Destroyer: Incinerate Damage enemies near Deathwing

deckard.name: Healing Potion
deckard.desc: Throw a Healing Potion on the ground that heals the first allied Hero that comes in contact with it for 285 (+4% per level).  Limit 5 active Potions.

deckard.name: Horadric Cube
deckard.desc: Release the Horadric Cube. After 0.5 seconds it explodes, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area and Slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds.

deckard.name: Scroll Of Sealing
deckard.desc: Unfurl an enchanted scroll over 2.25 seconds, forming a triangle that deals 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies inside and Roots them for 1.5 seconds.

deckard.name: Stay Awhile and Listen
deckard.desc: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

deckard.name: Lorenado
deckard.desc: Vector Targeting After 1 second, create a twirling tome tornado that travels towards the targeted direction, continually knocking away enemies that come into contact with it. Deals 20 (+4% per level) damage to Heroes hit.

deckard.name: Fortitude of the Faithful
deckard.desc: When at least 1 other allied Hero is nearby, Deckard gains 10 Armor and his Basic Abilities recharge 50% faster.

dehaka.name: Drag
dehaka.desc: Dehaka lashes out his tongue, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit, Stunning and dragging them with him for 1.75 seconds.  If Dehaka is Stunned or Silenced while using Drag, the effect ends.

dehaka.name: Dark Swarm
dehaka.desc: Deal 52 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for 3.5 seconds. While active, you are able to move through units. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

dehaka.name: Burrow
dehaka.desc: Burrow into the ground, entering Stasis and becoming Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While Burrowed, Dehaka can move at 50% movement speed.

dehaka.name: Isolation
dehaka.desc: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

dehaka.name: Adaptation
dehaka.desc: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

dehaka.name: Essence Collection
dehaka.desc: Heal Dehaka for 29 (+4% per level) Health per stored Essence over 5 seconds. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.  Passive: Gain 10 Essence from Takedowns and 2 Essence from nearby Minions dying. Maximum of 50 Essence.

diablo.name: Shadow Charge
diablo.desc: Charge an enemy, knocking them back, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage and gaining 15% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. If the enemy hits terrain, they are Stunned for 1 second and take an additional 130 (+4% per level) damage.

diablo.name: Fire Stomp
diablo.desc: Unleashes fire waves toward the targeted area that deal 12 (+4% per level) damage each. Once they reach maximum range they return, dealing an additional 36 (+4% per level) damage. Diablo heals for 130% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

diablo.name: Overpower
diablo.desc: Grabs the target and slams it behind Diablo, dealing 73 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning for 0.25 seconds.

diablo.name: Apocalypse
diablo.desc: Create a demonic rune under each enemy Hero on the battleground. After 1.75 seconds the rune explodes dealing 137 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.75 seconds.

diablo.name: Lightning Breath
diablo.desc: After 0.5 seconds, become Unstoppable and Channel for up to 4 seconds, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies in front of Diablo. Enemies affected are Slowed by 4% for 2 seconds, up to 40%.  Lightning Breath's direction changes with your mouse cursor position.

diablo.name: Black Soulstone
diablo.desc: Repeatable Quest: Gain 10 Souls per Hero killed and 1 Soul per Minion, up to 100. For each Soul, gain 0.3% maximum Health. If Diablo has 100 Souls upon dying, he will resurrect in 5 seconds but lose 100 Souls.  After reaching level 10, Diablo only consumes 75 Souls when resurrecting.

dva.name: Boosters
dva.desc: Increase D.Va's Movement Speed by 115% for 1.75 seconds. Enemies that are hit take 135 (+4% per level) damage and are knocked away.  D.Va cannot be Slowed while Boosters are active, and each enemy can only be hit once per use.

dva.name: Defense Matrix
dva.desc: Project a defensive field in the target direction for 3 seconds, reducing the damage dealt by enemy Heroes inside it by 50%.  Activate again to change the angle of projection.  Damage dealt to the Mech from enemies within Defense Matrix still grants the same amount of Self-Destruct Charge.

dva.name: Self-Destruct
dva.desc: Eject from the Mech, setting it to self-destruct after 4 seconds. Deals 400 (+4% per level) to 1100 (+4% per level) damage in a large area, depending on distance from center. Deals 50% damage against Structures.  Gain 1% Charge for every 2 seconds spent Basic Attacking, and 25% Charge per 100% of Mech Health lost.

dva.name: Bunny Hop
dva.desc: D.Va's Mech becomes Unstoppable and stomps every 0.5 seconds, dealing 70 (+4% per level) damage in a large area. Every 4th consecutive hit on a Hero deals 100% more damage and Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.  Lasts for 4 seconds.  Requires Mech Mode.

dva.name: Micro Missiles
dva.desc: After .375 seconds, Channel to launch a volley of 12 missiles in a target direction. Each missile impacts the first enemy in its path, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage in a small area and Slowing by 30% for 2 seconds.  Stores 2 charges with a 5 second cooldown between each use.  Requires Mech Mode.

dva.name: Mech Mode
dva.desc: When D.Va's Mech dies, she is ejected out after 0.75 seconds and can continue to fight. D.Va's Mech only awards 50% of a normal Hero's experience upon dying.  Fusion Cannons  D.Va's Mech Basic Attacks deal 22 (+4% per level) damage in a large area every 0.25 seconds. Deals 40% bonus damage against enemies very close to the Mech.

dva.name: Call Mech
dva.desc: Call a new Mech and enter Mech Mode.  Basic Attacks lower this cooldown by 0.5 seconds each.

dva.name: Pilot Mode
dva.desc: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Call Mech by 0.5 seconds. As a Pilot, D.Va only awards 50% of a normal Hero's experience upon dying.

dva.name: Torpedo Dash
dva.desc: Dash towards the target location, passing through enemies along the way.

dva.name: Concussive Pulse
dva.desc: Deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a cone and knock them back.

dva.name: Big Shot
dva.desc: Deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line. Heroes hit have their Movement Speed Slowed by 25% for 1.5 seconds. The cooldown of Call Mech is reduced by 5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit.  Requires Pilot Mode.

etc.name: Powerslide
etc.desc: Slide to a location dealing 105 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning enemies hit for 1.25 seconds.

etc.name: Face Melt
etc.desc: Deals 68 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back.

etc.name: Guitar Solo
etc.desc: Regenerate 66 (+4% per level) Health per second for 4 seconds.

etc.name: Mosh Pit
etc.desc: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

etc.name: Stage Dive
etc.desc: Leap to target location, landing after 2.75 seconds, dealing 330 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the area, and slowing them by 50% for 4 seconds.

etc.name: Rockstar
etc.desc: Using a Basic Ability grants 20 Armor for 2 seconds. Heroic Abilities grant 60 Armor.

falstad.name: Hammerang
falstad.desc: Throw out a Hammer that returns to Falstad, dealing 80 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies hit by 25% for 2 seconds. Reactive to explode the Hammer, dealing 95 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

falstad.name: Lightning Rod
falstad.desc: Deal 107 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy, and an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage per second for 4 seconds while close to the target. Deals 100% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

falstad.name: Barrel Roll
falstad.desc: Dashes forward and grants a 171 (+4% per level) point Shield for 3 seconds.

falstad.name: Mighty Gust
falstad.desc: Push enemies away, and slow their Movement Speed by 40% decaying over 4 seconds.

falstad.name: Hinterland Blast
falstad.desc: After 1 second, deal 475 (+4.75% per level) damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.

falstad.name: Tailwind
falstad.desc: Gain 15% increased Movement Speed after not taking damage for 5 seconds.

fenix.name: Plasma Cutter
fenix.desc: Create a laser beam at the target point that circles around Fenix twice, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Slowing them by 25% for 4 seconds.

fenix.name: Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon
fenix.desc: Basic Attack speed increased by 150%.  Activate to change to Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb, increasing Basic Attack range and damage, and causing Basic Attacks to splash.

fenix.name: Warp
fenix.desc: Warp to a targeted location, phasing out after 0.5 seconds, and arriving 0.75 seconds later.

fenix.name: Planet Cracker
fenix.desc: After 0.5 seconds, Channel a powerful beam that spans across the battleground for 4 seconds, dealing 112 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to non-Structure enemies hit.

fenix.name: Purification Salvo
fenix.desc: Channel for 1.5 seconds, sweeping a laser in front of Fenix that locks onto enemy Heroes. Once Channeling finishes, fire 5 missiles at each locked Hero, dealing 79 (+4% per level) damage each. Deals 50% increased damage to Slowed targets.

fenix.name: Shield Capacitor
fenix.desc: Fenix has a permanent 760 (+4% per level) Shield which regenerates at 10% per second after not taking damage for 5 seconds.

fenix.name: Weapon Mode: Phase Bomb
fenix.desc: Basic Attacks have 1.25 increased range, deal 25% more damage, and splash to nearby enemies.  Activate to change to Weapon Mode: Repeater Cannon, increasing Basic Attack speed.

gall.name: Shadowflame
gall.desc: Deal 135 (+5% per level) damage to enemies in the area.

gall.name: Dread Orb
gall.desc: Throw a bomb that will bounce three times, dealing 126 (+5% per level) damage to enemies.

gall.name: Runic Blast
gall.desc: Detonate Cho's Rune Bomb, dealing 210 (+4% per level) damage around it.

gall.name: Twisting Nether
gall.desc: After 1 second, nearby enemies are slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 (+5% per level) damage.

gall.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
gall.desc: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 (+4% per level) damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

gall.name: Ogre Rage
gall.desc: Activate to increase Gall's damage by 25%, but reduce Cho's Armor by 25.  Passive: Gall is permanently immune to Stun and Silence effects.

garrosh.name: Groundbreaker
garrosh.desc: Deal 81 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area. Heroes hit on the outer edge are Stunned for 0.5 seconds and then Slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.

garrosh.name: Bloodthirst
garrosh.desc: Deal 156 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and heal for 10% of Garrosh's missing Health. Healing is increased by 100% against Heroes.

garrosh.name: Wrecking Ball
garrosh.desc: Throw a nearby enemy Hero, Minion, or Mercenary to the target location, dealing 91 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the impact and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

garrosh.name: Warlord's Challenge
garrosh.desc: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

garrosh.name: Decimate
garrosh.desc: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second.  Stores up to 3 charges.

garrosh.name: Armor Up
garrosh.desc: Garrosh gains 1 Armor for every 2% of maximum Health missing.

gazlowe.name: Rock-It! Turret
gazlowe.desc: Create a turret that deals 36 (+4% per level) damage. Lasts for 15 seconds.  Turrets prioritize the nearest enemy Hero when first created.

gazlowe.name: Deth Lazor
gazlowe.desc: After 0.65 seconds, deal 175 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line. Heal for 25% of the damage dealt, increased to 75% against enemy Heroes.

gazlowe.name: Xplodium Charge
gazlowe.desc: Place a bomb that deals 142 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area after 1.25 seconds.  Enemies hit are also Stunned for 1 second.

gazlowe.name: Robo-Goblin
gazlowe.desc: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.  Passive: Basic Attacks deal 90 (+4% per level) bonus damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

gazlowe.name: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
gazlowe.desc: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area and deal 220 (+4% per level) damage. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

gazlowe.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
gazlowe.desc: Regenerate 1 Scrap every 4 seconds. Destroyed Rock-It! Turrets drop 1 Scrap, which can be picked up.  Activate to destroy a target Rock-It! Turret.

genji.name: Shuriken
genji.desc: Throw 3 Shuriken in a spread pattern, each dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.  Stores up to 3 charges.  Shuriken's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

genji.name: Deflect
genji.desc: Channel for 1.25 seconds, becoming Protected and blocking damage. Any damage blocked while channeling causes Genji to throw a Kunai toward the nearest enemy, prioritizing Heroes and dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage.  Total Damage Deflected: 0

genji.name: Swift Strike
genji.desc: Dash forward, dealing 190 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line. Enemy Heroes that die within 1.5 seconds of being hit with Swift Strike cause the cooldown and mana cost to be refunded.

genji.name: Dragonblade
genji.desc: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

genji.name: X-Strike
genji.desc: Perform two slashes dealing 145 (+4% per level) damage. The slashes detonate after 1.25 seconds causing an additional 290 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in their area.

genji.name: Cyber Agility
genji.desc: Activate to jump to the target area.

greymane.name: Gilnean Cocktail
greymane.desc: Hurl a flask that deals 55 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and explodes for 220 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a cone behind them.  Worgen: Razor Swipe Swipe forward, damaging enemies hit.

greymane.name: Inner Beast
greymane.desc: Gain 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh this duration, and reduce the cooldown of Inner Beast by 0.5 seconds.

greymane.name: Darkflight
greymane.desc: Shapeshift into a Worgen and leap at an enemy dealing 88 (+4% per level) damage.  Worgen: Disengage Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.

greymane.name: Go for the Throat
greymane.desc: Leap at an enemy Hero and shapeshift into a Worgen, slashing for 355 (+4% per level) damage. If this kills them, the Ability can be used a second time within 10 seconds for free.

greymane.name: Cursed Bullet
greymane.desc: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

greymane.name: Curse of the Worgen
greymane.desc: Greymane can use certain Abilities to shapeshift between a Human and a Worgen.  While Human, Greymane's Basic Attacks are ranged.  While Worgen, Greymane gains 10 Armor, and his Basic Attacks become melee but deal 40% more damage.

greymane.name: Razor Swipe
greymane.desc: Swipe in the targeted direction, dealing 126 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit.  Human: Gilnean Cocktail Damage the first enemy hit and deal heavy damage behind them.

greymane.name: Inner Beast
greymane.desc: Gain 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh this duration, and reduce the cooldown of Inner Beast by 0.5 seconds.

greymane.name: Disengage
greymane.desc: Roll away and shapeshift into a Human.  Human: Darkflight Leap at an enemy and shapeshift into a Worgen.

guldan.name: Fel Flame
guldan.desc: Release a wave of flame, dealing 210 (+4.5% per level) damage to enemies.

guldan.name: Drain Life
guldan.desc: Drain the life from an enemy over 3 seconds, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage per second and healing Gul'dan for 188 (+4% per level) Health per second.

guldan.name: Corruption
guldan.desc: Call forth three bursts of shadow energy, dealing 204 (+4.5% per level) damage over 6 seconds. Corruption can stack up to 3 times on an enemy.

guldan.name: Horrify
guldan.desc: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

guldan.name: Rain of Destruction
guldan.desc: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an area for 7 seconds. Each meteor deals 165 (+4% per level) damage in a small area.

guldan.name: Life Tap
guldan.desc: Gul'dan does not regenerate Mana.  Activate to restore 25% of Gul'dan's Mana.

hanzo.name: Storm Bow
hanzo.desc: Activate to charge an arrow that deals 291 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Storm Bow's range increases the longer it is Channeled.

hanzo.name: Scatter Arrow
hanzo.desc: Fire an arrow that deals 88 (+4% per level) to the first enemy Hero hit. Scatter Arrow can collide with terrain and Structures, splitting into 5 arrows that travel extra distance, ricochet up to 4 additional times, and deal 88 (+4% per level) damage each to the first enemy hit.

hanzo.name: Sonic Arrow
hanzo.desc: Fire an arrow that grants vision in a large area for 5 seconds. Enemies inside are revealed for 1 second. If Sonic Arrow lands directly on an enemy, it deals 165 (+4% per level) damage to them and follows them as they move.

hanzo.name: Dragonstrike
hanzo.desc: After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area.  Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

hanzo.name: Dragon's Arrow
hanzo.desc: Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

hanzo.name: Natural Agility
hanzo.desc: Jump over unpathable terrain or Structures, up to a maximum range.

hogger.name: Staggering Blow
hogger.desc: Swing your chain in a wide arc, dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. If an enemy hits terrain, deal an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage, Stun for 0.75 seconds, and gain 15 Rage.

hogger.name: Ez-Thro Dynamite
hogger.desc: Toss a bundle of Dynamite with a 1.5 second fuse. Upon detonation, enemies take 180 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.  The Dynamite instantly detonates when landing on an enemy Hero granting Hogger 10 Rage.

hogger.name: Hogg Wild
hogger.desc: After 0.25 seconds, become Unstoppable and uncontrollably spin towards the target direction, ricocheting off terrain. Ricocheting off terrain refreshes the duration.  Every 0.125 seconds, deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby non-Structure enemies. Damage against Heroes is increased by .5% for each point of Rage.

hogger.name: Hoardapult
hogger.desc: Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.  Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

hogger.name: Shockwave
hogger.desc: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

hogger.name: Loot Hoard
hogger.desc: Toss a pile of junk onto the battlefield, dealing 102 (+4% per level) damage in an area, knocking enemies away, and acting as terrain for up to 5 seconds.  When the Loot Hoard expires or is destroyed, a chunk of Meat falls out that can be picked up to restore 3% of maximum Health every second for 4 seconds.  Reactivate to destroy Loot Hoard.

illidan.name: Dive
illidan.desc: Dive at the target, dealing 66 (+4% per level) damage and flipping to the other side of the target.

illidan.name: Sweeping Strike
illidan.desc: Dash towards target point, dealing 119 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. Hitting an enemy increases Illidan's Basic Attack damage by 35% for 3 seconds.

illidan.name: Evasion
illidan.desc: Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2.5 seconds.

illidan.name: The Hunt
illidan.desc: Charge to target unit, dealing 251 (+4% per level) damage on impact and stunning for 1 second.

illidan.name: Metamorphosis
illidan.desc: Transform into Demon Form at the target location, dealing 46 (+4% per level) damage in the area. Temporarily increases maximum Health by 220 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit by the initial impact. Lasts for 18 seconds.

illidan.name: Betrayer's Thirst
illidan.desc: Basic Attacks heal for 30% of damage dealt and reduce Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

imperius.name: Celestial Charge
imperius.desc: Lunge towards a targeted direction and stab, dealing 35 (+4% per level) damage. If an enemy Hero is hit, Channel to Stun for 1 second and deal 80 (+4% per level) additional damage when it fully finishes.

imperius.name: Solarion's Fire
imperius.desc: Release a fiery wave that deals 110 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies hit by the center take 50% bonus damage and are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

imperius.name: Molten Armor
imperius.desc: Shroud Imperius in flames for 3 seconds, striking a nearby enemy for 19 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds. Imperius heals for 50% of the damage dealt, increased to 100% against Heroes.

imperius.name: Angelic Armaments
imperius.desc: Summon a ring of blazing swords that grants 850 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.  If the Shield lasts the full duration, this ability can be reactivated within 5 seconds to launch 6 swords toward an area, each dealing 140 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit.

imperius.name: Wrath of the Angiris
imperius.desc: After 0.75 seconds, charge in the target direction, lifting the first enemy Hero hit into the Heavens. While in the air, Imperius can steer the landing location by moving.  After 2 seconds, slam the target into the ground, dealing 375 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1 second.

imperius.name: Valorous Brand
imperius.desc: Each Basic Ability marks enemy Heroes hit for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks consume the target's marks, dealing 20% bonus damage per mark and healing for 75 (+4% per level) per mark.

jaina.name: Frostbolt
jaina.desc: Deal 184 (+4% per level) damage and Chill the target.

jaina.name: Blizzard
jaina.desc: Bombard an area with 3 waves of ice, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage each. Damaged enemies are Chilled.

jaina.name: Cone of Cold
jaina.desc: Deal 220 (+4% per level) damage and Chill targets.

jaina.name: Summon Water Elemental
jaina.desc: Summon a Water Elemental at target location. The Water Elemental's Basic Attacks deal 62 (+4% per level) damage, splash for 25% damage and Chill. The Ability can be reactivated to retarget the Water Elemental.  Lasts 20 seconds.

jaina.name: Ring of Frost
jaina.desc: After a 1.5 second delay, create a Ring of Frost in an area that deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Roots enemies for 3 seconds. The ring persists for 3 seconds afterward, Chilling any enemies who touch it.

jaina.name: Frostbite
jaina.desc: Jaina's Abilities Chill targets, Slowing them by 25% and amplifying damage taken from her Abilities by 50%. Lasts 4 seconds.  Quest: Deal 12000 Ability damage to Chilled Heroes.  Reward: Unlock the Improved Ice Block Ability, allowing Jaina to become temporarily Invulnerable.

johanna.name: Punish
johanna.desc: Step forward dealing 113 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 60% decaying over 2 seconds.

johanna.name: Condemn
johanna.desc: After 1 second, Johanna pulls nearby enemies toward her, Stunning them for 0.25 seconds and dealing 55 (+4% per level) damage. Deals 200% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

johanna.name: Shield Glare
johanna.desc: Deal 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Blind them for 1.5 seconds.

johanna.name: Falling Sword
johanna.desc: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

johanna.name: Blessed Shield
johanna.desc: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

johanna.name: Iron Skin
johanna.desc: Activate to grant Johanna a Shield that absorbs 810 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds. While this Shield is active, Johanna is Unstoppable.

junkrat.name: Frag Launcher
junkrat.desc: Launch a grenade that explodes at the end of its path or upon hitting an enemy, dealing 124 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Grenades can ricochet off of terrain. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.  Stores up to 4 charges. Frag Launcher's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

junkrat.name: Concussion Mine
junkrat.desc: Place a mine on the ground. Junkrat's Trait can be activated to detonate the mine, dealing 180 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage.  Limit 1 active mine.

junkrat.name: Steel Trap
junkrat.desc: Place a trap on the ground that arms after 2 seconds. Deals 130 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy that walks over it and Roots them for 2 seconds.  Limit 1 active trap.

junkrat.name: RIP-Tire
junkrat.desc: Create a motorized bomb with 530 (+4% per level) Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.  RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 (+4% per level) damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 (+4% per level) to enemies on the edge.

junkrat.name: Rocket Ride
junkrat.desc: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving.  After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

junkrat.name: Total Mayhem
junkrat.desc: Upon dying, drop 5 grenades that explode after 0.75 seconds, each dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals 75% less damage to Structures.  Detonate Mine  Detonate an active Concussion Mine.

kaelthas.name: Flamestrike
kaelthas.desc: After 1 second, deal 345 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  Verdant Spheres increases the radius by 50%.

kaelthas.name: Living Bomb
kaelthas.desc: Deal 126 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to an enemy, then they explode dealing 215 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies.  Other Heroes damaged by this explosion are also affected by Living Bomb, though the secondary explosions cannot spread.  Verdant Spheres makes this Ability cost no Mana and have no cooldown.

kaelthas.name: Gravity Lapse
kaelthas.desc: Stun the first enemy hit for 1 second.  Verdant Spheres causes Gravity Lapse to stun the first 3 enemies hit and increases the stun duration by 50%.

kaelthas.name: Pyroblast
kaelthas.desc: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

kaelthas.name: Phoenix
kaelthas.desc: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84 (+4% per level) damage and splashing for 42 (+4% per level) damage.

kaelthas.name: Verdant Spheres
kaelthas.desc: Activate to make Kael'thas's next Basic Ability more powerful.

kelthuzad.name: Death and Decay
kelthuzad.desc: After 0.5 seconds, launch an orb that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 150 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. The explosion leaves behind a pool of decay that lasts 2 seconds, dealing 82 (+2.5% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies.

kelthuzad.name: Frost Nova
kelthuzad.desc: Create a nova that explodes after 1 second, dealing 180 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies inside and Slowing them by 35% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center are Rooted for 1 second.

kelthuzad.name: Chains of Kel'Thuzad
kelthuzad.desc: Launch a chain, dealing 97 (+2.5% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit. For 3 seconds after hitting an enemy, Chains can be reactivated to launch to an additional enemy, pulling both enemies together and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

kelthuzad.name: Frost Blast
kelthuzad.desc: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115 (+2.5% per level) damage to its target and 275 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

kelthuzad.name: Shadow Fissure
kelthuzad.desc: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 (+2.5% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

kelthuzad.name: Master of the Cold Dark
kelthuzad.desc: Quest: Gain 1 Blight every time a Hero is Rooted by Frost Nova or hit by Chains of Kel'Thuzad.  Reward: After gaining 15 Blight, gain the Glacial Spike Ability.  Reward: After gaining 30 Blight, gain 75% Spell Power.  Blight: 0/30

kerrigan.name: Ravage
kerrigan.desc: Leap to a target, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage. If the enemy dies within 1.5 seconds, restore 1 charge and refund 20 Mana.

kerrigan.name: Impaling Blades
kerrigan.desc: After 1.25 seconds, deal 165 (+4% per level) damage to enemies within the target area, Stunning them for 1 second.

kerrigan.name: Primal Grasp
kerrigan.desc: Pulls enemies within the target area towards Kerrigan, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage. After 2.5 seconds, an explosion occurs around Kerrigan, dealing 195 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

kerrigan.name: Summon Ultralisk
kerrigan.desc: After 0.5 seconds, summon an Ultralisk that rushes forward upon spawning, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  The Ultralisk's Basic Attacks deal 50% of their damage in an area around their target. Reactivate to retarget the Ultralisk.

kerrigan.name: Maelstrom
kerrigan.desc: Deals 74 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Lasts for 7 seconds.

kerrigan.name: Assimilation
kerrigan.desc: Gain 10% of damage dealt from Basic Attacks and Abilities as Shields for 6 seconds. Shield amount gained doubled against Heroes.  Current maximum: 1004 (+4% per level)

kharazim.name: Radiant Dash
kharazim.desc: Jump to an allied or enemy unit. Enemies are immediately hit with a Basic Attack.  Stores up to 2 charges.

kharazim.name: Breath of Heaven
kharazim.desc: Heal nearby Heroes for 285 (+4% per level) and give them 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

kharazim.name: Deadly Reach
kharazim.desc: Kharazim's next Basic Attack increases his Attack Speed and Attack Range by 100% for 2 seconds.

kharazim.name: Seven-Sided Strike
kharazim.desc: Become Invulnerable and strike 7 times over 2 seconds. Each strike hits the highest Health nearby Hero for 7% of their maximum Health.

kharazim.name: Divine Palm
kharazim.desc: Protect an allied Hero from death, causing them to be healed for 1200 (+4% per level) if they take fatal damage in the next 3 seconds.

kharazim.name: Pick Your Trait
kharazim.desc: Choose between Transcendence, Iron Fists, and Insight from the Talents panel.

leoric.name: Skeletal Swing
leoric.desc: Leoric swings his mace, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is hit, refund 50% of the cooldown and Mana cost. Deals 75% additional damage to Minions. Peasants!

leoric.name: Drain Hope
leoric.desc: Grab an enemy Hero's soul, dealing up to 20% of their maximum Health as damage and healing Leoric for up to 20% of his maximum Health while he is nearby, over 4 seconds. Leoric's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% while this is active.

leoric.name: Wraith Walk
leoric.desc: Leoric separates from his body, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed accelerating up to 50% over 2.5 seconds. When Wraith Walk ends or is canceled, his body jumps to his wraith.

leoric.name: Entomb
leoric.desc: Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.

leoric.name: March of the Black King
leoric.desc: Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 (+4% per level) damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.

leoric.name: Undying
leoric.desc: Leoric becomes a ghost when he dies, and resurrects upon reaching full Health. Leoric deals no damage while dead.  Wrath Of The Bone King  Leoric's first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage, and his third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target.

leoric.name: Drain Essence
leoric.desc: Throw out a chain, attaching to the first enemy Hero hit, healing Leoric for up to 10% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds as long as the enemy remains close.

lili.name: Healing Brew
lili.desc: Heal the lowest Health allied Hero within 6 range for 175 (+4% per level) Health.

lili.name: Cloud Serpent
lili.desc: Summon a Cloud Serpent on an allied Hero that attacks nearby enemies every second. Each attack deals 26 (+4% per level) damage and heals the ally for 20 (+4% per level). Lasts for 8 seconds.

lili.name: Blinding Wind
lili.desc: Throw a cloud of wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 133 (+4% per level) damage. Heroes hit are Blinded and Slowed by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

lili.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
lili.desc: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 66 (+4% per level) Health.

lili.name: Water Dragon
lili.desc: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300 (+4% per level) damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

lili.name: Fast Feet
lili.desc: Upon taking damage, your Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 50% faster and you gain 10% Movement Speed for 1 second.

liming.name: Magic Missiles
liming.desc: Fire three missiles toward an area, each dealing 147 (+3.5% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. These missiles do 50% damage to Structures.

liming.name: Arcane Orb
liming.desc: Fire an Orb that powers up as it travels, dealing 135 (+3% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Damage is increased the further it travels, up to 270 (+3% per level) more damage.

liming.name: Disintegrate
liming.desc: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

liming.name: Wave of Force
liming.desc: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

liming.name: Critical Mass
liming.desc: Getting a Takedown will refresh the cooldown on all of Li-Ming's Abilities.

lostvikings.name: Spin To Win!
lostvikings.desc: Activate to have each Viking deal 85 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.  Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

lostvikings.name: Jump!
lostvikings.desc: Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

lostvikings.name: Viking Bribery
lostvikings.desc: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

lostvikings.name: Longboat Raid!
lostvikings.desc: Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 (+4% per level) damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 (+4% per level) damage in an area.  The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 15 seconds.  Requires all surviving Vikings to be nearby.

lostvikings.name: Play Again!
lostvikings.desc: Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds.  Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

lostvikings.name: Viking Hoard
lostvikings.desc: Gathering a Regeneration Globe with a Viking permanently increases all their Health Regeneration by 0.5 per second.  Current Bonus: 0 Regen per second

lostvikings.name: Norse Force!
lostvikings.desc: All Vikings gain a 140 (+4% per level) to 308 (+4% per level) point Shield, increasing in strength for each Viking alive. Lasts 4 seconds.

lostvikings.name: Nordic Attack Squad
lostvikings.desc: While Olaf, Baleog, and Erik are near each of the other two Vikings, their Basic Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 1.25% maximum Health to enemy Heroes.

lostvikings.name: Mortar
lostvikings.desc: Fires a mortar at the targeted location, dealing 228 (+4% per level) damage in a large area.

ltmorales.name: Healing Beam
ltmorales.desc: Heal target allied Hero or Minion for 172 (+4% per level) Health per second as long as they are in range. After not channeling Healing Beam for 2 seconds, regenerate 6 Energy per second.  Reactivate to switch targets, or self-cast to cancel channeling.

ltmorales.name: Safeguard
ltmorales.desc: Grant target ally Hero 35 Armor for 3 seconds.

ltmorales.name: Displacement Grenade
ltmorales.desc: Fire a grenade that can be manually detonated, dealing 208 (+4% per level) to nearby enemies and knocking them away.

ltmorales.name: Stim Drone
ltmorales.desc: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

ltmorales.name: Medivac Dropship
ltmorales.desc: Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac.

ltmorales.name: Caduceus Reactor
ltmorales.desc: While channeling Healing Beam, Lt. Morales regenerates 2% of her maximum Health per second.

lucio.name: Soundwave
lucio.desc: Deal 105 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

lucio.name: Crossfade
lucio.desc: Currently playing Speed Boost, increasing the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by 10%.  Toggle to play Healing Boost instead.

lucio.name: Amp It Up
lucio.desc: Raise Lúcio's Crossfade track volume for 3 seconds, amping Healing Boost to 112 (+4% per level) Health per second and Speed Boost to 30% increased Movement Speed.

lucio.name: Sound Barrier
lucio.desc: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

lucio.name: High Five
lucio.desc: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

lucio.name: Push Off
lucio.desc: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide towards a targeted location. Enemies hit take 100 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1 second.

lunara.name: Noxious Blossom
lunara.desc: After 0.5 seconds, cause an area to explode with pollen dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage.

lunara.name: Crippling Spores
lunara.desc: Enemies currently afflicted by Nature's Toxin have its duration increased by 3 seconds and are Slowed by 40% decaying over 3 seconds.

lunara.name: Wisp
lunara.desc: Spawn a Wisp to scout an area. Can be redirected once active. When the Wisp is in a bush for more 2 seconds, its vision radius is increased by 75%.  Lasts 45 seconds.

lunara.name: Thornwood Vine
lunara.desc: Send forth vines that deal 184 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in a line.  Stores up to 3 charges.

lunara.name: Leaping Strike
lunara.desc: Leap over an enemy, Slowing them by 80% for 0.35 seconds and dealing 271 (+4% per level) damage.  Stores up to 2 charges.

lunara.name: Nature's Toxin
lunara.desc: Lunara's Basic Attacks and damaging Abilities poison their target, dealing 33 (+4% per level) damage a second for 3 seconds. Every additional application increases the duration by 3 seconds, up to a maximum of 9 seconds.

maiev.name: Fan of Knives
maiev.desc: Deal 152 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a crescent area.  Hitting at least 2 enemy Heroes with Fan of Knives reduces its cooldown to 0.5 seconds, and refunds its Mana cost.

maiev.name: Umbral Bind
maiev.desc: Maiev's next Basic Attack cleaves and applies a tether to enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. If a tethered Hero moves too far from Maiev, they are pulled toward her, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage and breaking the tether.

maiev.name: Spirit of Vengeance
maiev.desc: Send a shadow of Maiev outward that will return to its cast location, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies along both paths. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce the cooldown by 4 seconds.

maiev.name: Containment Disc
maiev.desc: Throw a glaive in the target direction. If an enemy Hero is hit, Containment Disc can be reactivated to remove their vision and Time Stop them for 4 seconds. Leaving Containment Silences the enemy Hero for 1.5 seconds.  Containment Disc automatically activates 6 seconds after hitting a Hero.

maiev.name: Warden's Cage
maiev.desc: Summon 8 Warden Avatars as a cage around Maiev. After 1.5 seconds, enemy Heroes that come in contact with an Avatar consume it and are knocked to the center of the cage. Warden Avatars last 5 seconds.

maiev.name: Vault of the Wardens
maiev.desc: Leap into the air, becoming Immune to all hostile effects for 0.75 seconds.  After reaching Level 20, Vault of the Wardens gains an additional charge.

malfurion.name: Regrowth
malfurion.desc: Heal an allied Hero for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 20 seconds.

malfurion.name: Moonfire
malfurion.desc: Deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and reveal them for 2 seconds.  Allies with an active Regrowth are healed for 130 (+4% per level) Health for each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire.

malfurion.name: Entangling Roots
malfurion.desc: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117 (+4% per level) damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

malfurion.name: Tranquility
malfurion.desc: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80 (+4% per level) Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

malfurion.name: Twilight Dream
malfurion.desc: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310 (+4% per level) damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

malfurion.name: Innervate
malfurion.desc: Grant an allied Hero 20% of their maximum Mana over 5 seconds. While affected by Innervate, their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.  Cannot be used on Heroes that do not use Mana.

malganis.name: Fel Claws
malganis.desc: Violently slash in the chosen direction, dealing 66 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.  Reactivate to slash up to 2 more times. The third slash Stuns enemies for 0.75 seconds.

malganis.name: Necrotic Embrace
malganis.desc: Desecrate the air, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and gaining 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

malganis.name: Night Rush
malganis.desc: After 0.75 seconds, gain 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. While active, Mal'Ganis can move through enemy Heroes and put them to Sleep for 2.5 seconds.

malganis.name: Dark Conversion
malganis.desc: Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

malganis.name: Carrion Swarm
malganis.desc: After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.  Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.

malganis.name: Vampiric Touch
malganis.desc: Mal'Ganis heals for 45% of damage dealt to enemy Heroes and 10% of damage dealt to non-Heroes.

malthael.name: Soul Rip
malthael.desc: Extract the souls of nearby enemies afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 100 (+4% per level) damage and healing Malthael for 25 (+4% per level) per target hit. Heroic targets heal Malthael for an additional 4% of the Hero's maximum Health.

malthael.name: Wraith Strike
malthael.desc: Instantly teleport through an enemy afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage and refreshing Reaper's Mark.

malthael.name: Death Shroud
malthael.desc: After 0.25 seconds, unleash a wave of dark mist that applies Reaper's Mark to enemies it hits.

malthael.name: Tormented Souls
malthael.desc: Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.  When Tormented Souls is cast and when it expires, reset the cooldown of Wraith Strike.

malthael.name: Last Rites
malthael.desc: Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.  Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

malthael.name: Reaper's Mark
malthael.desc: Basic Attacks cleave in an area in front of Malthael and afflict non-Structure targets with Reaper's Mark for 4 seconds.  Marked enemies are revealed and take damage equal to 2% of their maximum Health every 1 second.

medivh.name: Arcane Rift
medivh.desc: Launch a rift that deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds and refund 50 Mana.  Quest: Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Arcane Rift without dying.  Reward: Permanently increase the damage dealt by 75 and cooldown reduction for hitting a Hero by 1 second.

medivh.name: Force of Will
medivh.desc: Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds.  Upon expiration, Force of Will heals the target for 20% of the damage it absorbed.

medivh.name: Portal
medivh.desc: Create a set of portals between Medivh and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between both. The portals last 6 seconds.

medivh.name: Poly Bomb
medivh.desc: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

medivh.name: Ley Line Seal
medivh.desc: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

medivh.name: Raven Form
medivh.desc: Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.

mei.name: Snow Blind
mei.desc: Throw a snowball that hits all enemies in an area. Enemies hit take 70 (+4% per level) damage, are Slowed by 35%, and are Blinded for 1.75 seconds.

mei.name: Blizzard
mei.desc: Command Snowball to create a Blizzard at the target location for 2 seconds. Enemies within the blizzard take 13 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds and are Slowed by 7%, stacking up to 35%. When the Blizzard ends, enemies within its area take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 1.25 seconds.

mei.name: Icing
mei.desc: Slide quickly in the targeted direction. When this effect ends, enemies near Mei are knocked back, take 52 (+4% per level) damage, and are Slowed by 80%, rapidly decaying over 1.5 seconds.  Can be canceled during sliding.

mei.name: Avalanche
mei.desc: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds per Hero consumed.

mei.name: Ice Wall
mei.desc: Vector Targeting After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75%, decaying over 3 seconds.

mei.name: Cryo-Freeze
mei.desc: Become encased in ice for 3 seconds, gaining a rapidly decaying Shield that absorbs up to 1104 (+4% per level) damage. While active, this Shield grants Unstoppable and restores up to 35% of Mei's maximum Health.

mephisto.name: Skull Missile
mephisto.desc: Conjure a skull that travels in the target direction after 0.625 seconds, dealing 127 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and Slowing Heroes hit by 25% for 2 seconds.

mephisto.name: Lightning Nova
mephisto.desc: A ring of lightning appears around Mephisto for 2.5 seconds. Enemies within the ring take 43 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds.  Each time a cast of Lightning Nova hits a Hero, its damage is increased by 3%, up to 30%.

mephisto.name: Shade of Mephisto
mephisto.desc: Teleport to a location, dealing 78 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and leaving behind a Shade of Mephisto at Mephisto's original location.  After 2.5 seconds, Mephisto is teleported back to the Shade's location.

mephisto.name: Consume Souls
mephisto.desc: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 (+4% per level) damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

mephisto.name: Durance of Hate
mephisto.desc: After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 (+4% per level) damage to them over the same duration.  Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

mephisto.name: Lord Of Hatred
mephisto.desc: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Abilities reduces Mephisto's Basic Ability cooldowns.  Skull Missile and Shade of Mephisto grant 1.5 seconds of cooldown reduction per Hero hit, and Lightning Nova grants 0.3 seconds per Hero hit.

muradin.name: Storm Bolt
muradin.desc: Throw a hammer, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  After reaching level 10, Storm Bolt pierces to hit an additional target. Muradin's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Storm Bolt by 1 second and restore 3 Mana.

muradin.name: Thunder Clap
muradin.desc: Blast nearby enemies for 96 (+4% per level) damage and Slow them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 30% for the duration.

muradin.name: Dwarf Toss
muradin.desc: Leap to target location, dealing 59 (+4% per level) damage to enemies on landing. Upon leaping, gain 30 Armor for 2 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

muradin.name: Avatar
muradin.desc: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

muradin.name: Haymaker
muradin.desc: Stun target enemy Hero, and wind up a punch dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking the target back, hitting enemies in the way for 319 (+4% per level) damage and knocking them aside.

muradin.name: Second Wind
